summary: A faithful outline of a Stage 4 73 wrapped around a hollow instrument. Geometry is good - 1396.8x451.3px, aspect 3.09507 vs 3.0951, deck 0.53997 / keybed 0.45999, width 0.97, 43+30 keys, black-key height 0.60994, 5/5 colours inside dE 12 - but the section widths keep the superseded coarse fractions (piano 0.1486 vs 0.085) and .panel-controls{overflow:hidden} buries 15 of 163 controls out of pointer reach. Every control is a native range slider: no knob caps, no drawbars, no LED ladders. Behaviour is where it breaks. Organ and Synth render pure silence (rms 0.000143, 0 voices) because defaultLayerScene ships their scene flags false and no control can flip them, so two of the three Phase 3 engines cannot be played. The 32-slot program system is a tested module the app never imports, so no program, split, scene or morph workflow works. In the effects graph all 12 DelayNodes have no path to the destination and all 6 ConvolverNodes have no input: Delay, Mod 2 and Reverb are level changes with no echo or tail, and the rotary never engages. Mod 1, Amp/EQ, Compressor, bypass, master level, piano layers, polyphony and cleanup are real. There is no Web MIDI at all, and sustain never engages.

evidence: Measured in the served build at 1440x900 with a recording tap patched onto AudioNode.prototype.connect at the destination: with Piano Layer A switched off and Organ Layer A+B enabled, all nine drawbars at 8, Organ level 127, and Synth Layer A/B/C enabled at level 127, the rendered output is the DC floor (rms 0.000143, peak 0.000143) and the panel voice counter reads 'Voices: 0'. With Piano back on the same gesture gives rms 0.002219 / 1 voice - only the piano ever spawns a voice.

Cause is in the shipped state, not the engines: defaultLayerScene() in src/audio/program-types.ts returns organA:false, organB:false, synthA:false, synthB:false, synthC:false, and PianoEngine.noteOn() skips a layer when its scene flag is false (engine.ts:373, :385) while applyState() also holds organLayerInputs/synthLayerInputs at gain 0. No panel control writes program-scene-i-active / program-scene-ii-active, the only keys presentationToAudioState reads for scene selection, so there is no route to turn either engine on.

The organ (additive B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe with per-model ratios and oscillator types) and synth (Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H stacks) code is genuinely written and distinct in source, and organ.test.ts / synth.test.ts exercise it via renderOffline - but the shipped instrument is one engine, the piano, with the other two unreachable. Piano types are audibly distinct (C4 harmonic-band energies: Grand [0.076,11.58,0.08,3.66,...], Electric [0.021,2.542,0.027,0.551,...], Clav [0.009,0.065,...]).

Graph census of the single live AudioContext (207 nodes / 242 edges, 1 AudioContext, 1 AudioDestinationNode, 61 OfflineAudioContexts used only to bake piano samples): all 12 DelayNodes have in-degree 1 and out-degree 1 but ZERO path to the destination - the Delay unit's line (delayNode->delayFilter->delayFeedback->delayNode) and Mod 2's line are closed loops that nothing feeds and that feed nothing (effects-chain.ts:112-120). All 6 ConvolverNodes have in-degree 0; the reverb convolver is wired to reverbWet but nothing is wired into it (effects-chain.ts:136).

Confirmed on rendered signal, fresh page per condition, 1.2s held note: Delay at time 127 / feedback 120 / mix 127 gives rms 0.001365 vs dry 0.001418, an identical envelope and tailSum 7.29 vs 7.33 - no echo of any kind. Reverb at size 110 / mix 127 gives the same envelope scaled 1.6x with tailSum 5.31, LESS tail than dry - a level change, not a reverb. Mod 2 at max is likewise level-only. Mod 1 is real (envelope 8.78-5.11-1.96-3.68-6.59 at ~8.5 Hz, matching its rate mapping), and Amp/EQ, Compressor and All-Bypass all measurably change the signal.

The structural requirements do hold: one AudioContext, per-layer input gains, six LayerEffectChain instances in the documented Mod1->Mod2->Delay->Amp/EQ->Comp->Reverb order, master gain, limiter and a single destination. But four of the six chains (organ + synth A/B/C) carry no signal at all because those engines never sound, and three of the six units inside the two live chains are disconnected, so 'every engine inherits the shared effects graph' is not met.

18 computer keys held simultaneously produced 'Voices: 18' with 18 .key.is-pressed elements, returned cleanly to 'Voices: 0' on release, and 60 rapid note-on/off cycles in 579ms left 0 stuck voices. window blur cleanup drops held voices (Voices 1 -> 0). No pageerror and no console error in any probe session; the page stayed responsive throughout.

Musical quality is thin and quiet: the piano is a 5-root x 2-velocity bank of offline-rendered sine+harmonic tones, and peak output at the destination for a normal keystroke is about 0.010 full-scale. The default program is also permanently tremolo'd - Mod 1 ships with amount 64 and bypass false, so mod1LfoGain sits at 0.24 and every dry note visibly warbles at ~4.5 Hz (baseline envelope 6.0-5.0-3.8-2.4-1.8-1.8-2.5-3.1-3.5 with a ~220ms period), which disappears the moment All Effects Bypass is engaged.

src/state/programs.ts (32 slots, 8 Live slots, store/store-as, dirty flag, localStorage persist/restore, factory seeds) is imported by nothing except its own test file - grep for 'state/programs' across src returns only programs.test.ts. App.tsx renders <Instrument> from useInstrument(), which never touches the program system.

Driven in the build: clicking Program 3, Page Up, Store, Store As and Live Mode leaves the Program OLED reading 'Grand Model' throughout, Object.keys(localStorage) stays empty, and after a reload Program 3 is back to aria-pressed=false with nothing recalled. The Dirty Indicator control exists but is one of the 15 controls clipped out of reach, and nothing sets it. There is no state round-trip to lose or preserve.

Master Level is real: setting it to 20 dropped the measured envelope peak from 12.1 to 3.8 (x0.31, matching the 20/127 vs 64/127 mapping). Piano Layer B enable adds a second voice ('Voices: 1' -> 'Voices: 2' -> 'Voices: 1'). Pointer velocity is position-dependent and pressed state tracks correctly (aria-pressed true/false, .is-pressed).

Sustain has no working path. instrument.ts:141-143 reads COMPUTER_KEY_MAP[e.key.toLowerCase()] and returns when it is null BEFORE testing e.code === 'Space', and the map has no space entry - measured with focus explicitly cleared, holding Space then playing and releasing a note leaves 'Voices: 0', i.e. the note is released anyway.

There is no Web MIDI at all: navigator.requestMIDIAccess appears zero times in the source and zero times in build/assets/index-BfTeCzmF.js. useInstrument defaults to createMockMidiPort('connected'), an in-memory object only tests can drive, so no hardware controller can reach the instrument. Panic is inert (Voices: 1 before and after clicking it), Transpose Up/Down latch but are never read by presentationToAudioState, the Program Transpose knob that is read is unreachable, and the mod wheel only feeds a morph table that is always empty.

Splits: the Split button latches aria-pressed=true but presentationToAudioState reads 'program-split-on', a key no rendered control writes, so split.enabled never becomes true; the split position, crossfade and zone editing UI does not exist on the panel at all. Scenes: Scene I / Scene II latch, but the state reads 'program-scene-i-active'/'program-scene-ii-active', again unwritten, and both scenes are identical defaults anyway.

Transpose and Panic were driven directly and neither changes anything (Panic: 'Voices: 1' before and after; Transpose Up only sets its own aria-checked). And because Organ and Synth never sound, 'correct across all three engines at once' cannot be demonstrated in any case - the measured silence with piano off is the whole cross-engine surface.

The organ produces no audio in the shipped build (measured DC floor, 0 voices, with both layers enabled, all drawbars at 8 and level 127). Nine drawbars, four model switches, percussion level/soft/fast, key click, vibrato and rotary controls are all rendered and all wired to presentation state, but only drawbars, level, key click and perc soft/fast are read back into audio state.

Even setting the silence aside, the model selector is broken twice over: the model switches are ControlKind 'toggle', so interactControl skips cyclePresentationControl and never clears the others - after clicking B3 then Vox both report aria-checked=true - and presentationToAudioState resolves the model with ORGAN_MODELS.find(), so B3 wins permanently once lit. Percussion has no On control anywhere in CONTROLS (only level/soft/fast), so organ.percussion.on can never become true, and organ-vib-chorus is never read, so vibOn/vibChorus stay at their defaults.

Rotary is inert: fx.rotaryOn is read from 'fx-rotary-on' and organ.rotaryRoute from 'fx-organ-rotary', neither of which exists as a control, so SharedRotary.apply() is always called with on=false and its wet gain stays 0. Measured with To Rotary engaged: slow and fast are indistinguishable (sustain CV 0.5605 vs 0.5641, tailSum 9.76 vs 9.63, near-identical envelopes) and neither shows any amplitude modulation.

The synth produces no audio in the shipped build (measured DC floor with layers A/B/C enabled and level 127; voice counter stays at 0 with the piano off). The panel carries 38 synth controls, but the waveform category is read from 'synth-cat-pure'/'synth-cat-sync'/... which are not rendered controls, and the three Osc Wave knobs that are rendered are never read at all - the Synth OLED confirms it, reading 'Init Synth' before and after driving Osc A Wave to 127.

The engine itself is missing pieces the phase requires: spawnSynthVoiceInternal (engine.ts:573-597) builds oscillators, one static filter and a single attack ramp - there is no LFO node anywhere in the synth voice, no decay/sustain/release stage, no filter envelope, and unison/glide/voice-mode are stored but never used. Filter type is never set from the panel (filterType stays LP24). Voice Poly/Mono/Legato, Glide and Unison are additionally among the 15 controls clipped out of pointer reach.

The arpeggiator has a hanging-timer defect: scheduleArp installs a setInterval that spawns voices from a sequence captured at schedule time and is only cleared by allNotesOff/panic; noteOff removes the note from arpNotes but never stops the timer (engine.ts:599-611). It could not be exercised audibly because the synth is silent.

Piano layering is real and observable: enabling Piano Layer B takes a single keystroke from 'Voices: 1' to 'Voices: 2' and back, and layer level/octave/enable all reach the audio state through per-layer input gains. That is the only working member of this group.

Splits, scenes and morphs are all panel-only. Split, Scene I/II and the three Morph Assign buttons latch aria-pressed but write presentation keys that presentationToAudioState never reads ('program-split-on', 'program-scene-i-active', 'program-scene-ii-active'), and there is no morph assignment UI at all, so state.morph.wheel/pedal stay empty arrays and applyMorphToValue is a no-op for every destination. Layer scenes are additionally the mechanism that silences Organ and Synth, so the scene system is not merely absent, it is actively holding two engines off.

No program storage or recall exists in the running build. The 32-slot/8-Live-slot system in src/state/programs.ts is never imported by the app; driving Program 1-8, Page Up/Down, Store, Store As and Live Mode changes nothing but the buttons' own aria-pressed, the Program OLED stays on 'Grand Model' (it only ever echoes the selected piano type), localStorage stays empty, and a reload recalls nothing.

The program buttons are not even mutually exclusive - Program 3 stays latched while other buttons are pressed - and there is no page indicator, no program name, no numeric list view and no dirty indicator behaviour on the panel, so none of the workflows the phase contract lists can be performed.

issues.title: Organ and Synth engines are silent in the shipped build
issues.detail: With Piano Layer A off and Organ A/B + Synth A/B/C enabled (all drawbars 8, levels 127) the destination renders the DC floor (rms 0.000143) and the voice counter stays at 0. defaultLayerScene() ships organA/organB/synthA/synthB/synthC = false; noteOn() skips a layer whose scene flag is false and applyState() pins those layer input gains to 0. The only keys that could flip the scene ('program-scene-i-active', 'program-scene-ii-active') are never written by any rendered control, so there is no route to make either engine sound. Two of the three engines that define Phase 3 cannot be played.

issues.title: The program system is implemented but never mounted
issues.detail: src/state/programs.ts implements 32 slots, 8 Live slots, store/store-as, dirty tracking and localStorage persistence, and programs.test.ts passes against it - but nothing in the app imports it. Driving Program 1-8, Page Up/Down, Store, Store As and Live Mode in the build changes only the buttons' own aria-pressed; the Program OLED never leaves 'Grand Model', localStorage stays empty and a reload recalls nothing. A green test suite is covering a module that is not in the product.

issues.title: Delay, Mod 2 and Reverb are disconnected from the signal path in all six effect chains
issues.detail: Graph census of the live AudioContext: all 12 DelayNodes have zero path to the destination (each is a closed delayNode->filter->feedback->delayNode loop that the chain neither feeds nor reads), and all 6 ConvolverNodes have in-degree 0 while still being wired to reverbWet. Measured on rendered signal: Delay at time/feedback/mix maxed is indistinguishable from dry (rms 0.001365 vs 0.001418, tailSum 7.29 vs 7.33, identical envelope, no echo); Reverb at max is the dry signal scaled 1.6x with LESS tail than dry; Mod 2 at max is level-only. Their knobs still change the output level, so the units read as working while producing none of their namesake behaviour.

issues.title: 15 panel controls are rendered but can never be reached by a pointer
issues.detail: .panel-controls sets overflow:hidden with no scroll affordance (styles.css:108-115); at 1440x900 the Synth panel reports scrollHeight 227 vs clientHeight 189. A 5x5 elementFromPoint grid over every control box finds 148/163 reachable; organ-layer-b-enable, organ-layer-a/b-octave, piano-string-res, piano-sustped, piano-pstick, piano-section-on, program-transpose, program-dirty, synth-arp-range, synth-voice-poly/mono/legato, synth-glide and synth-unison get zero hits, and 17 more are half-clipped. Program Transpose is the only control bound to transposition, so an entire documented feature is behind a clipped edge.

issues.title: No Web MIDI implementation and no working sustain
issues.detail: navigator.requestMIDIAccess occurs zero times in src/ and zero times in build/assets/index-BfTeCzmF.js; useInstrument defaults to createMockMidiPort('connected'), an in-memory stub only tests can drive, so no hardware controller can reach the instrument. Separately, the Space keydown handler returns before its own e.code === 'Space' branch because COMPUTER_KEY_MAP has no space entry (instrument.ts:141-143); measured with focus cleared, holding Space and releasing a note still drops it to 'Voices: 0'. Both are Phase 1 hard-gate behaviours regressed by Phase 3.

issues.title: Rotary speaker is permanently disengaged and Slow/Fast do nothing
issues.detail: SharedRotary.apply() is driven by fx.rotaryOn || organ.rotaryRoute, read from 'fx-rotary-on' and 'fx-organ-rotary' - neither of which exists as a rendered control - so its wet gain never leaves 0 and its LFO never reaches the audio path. Measured with To Rotary engaged and drive 127: slow and fast are indistinguishable (sustain CV 0.5605 vs 0.5641, tailSum 9.76 vs 9.63) and neither shows any amplitude modulation. The Rotary Slow/Fast/Stop buttons light as engaged regardless.

issues.title: Organ model switches are non-exclusive and only B3 is ever applied
issues.detail: The four model switches are ControlKind 'toggle', so interactControl bypasses cyclePresentationControl and never clears the siblings - after clicking B3 then Vox, both report aria-checked=true and both LEDs are lit. presentationToAudioState then resolves the model with ORGAN_MODELS.find(), which returns B3 first, so Vox/Farf/Pipe can never take effect even if the organ were audible.

issues.title: Section widths follow the superseded coarse spec fractions
issues.detail: SECTIONS in src/model/hardware.ts still uses 0.13/0.21/0.15/0.09/0.21/0.21, the values specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json v1.3.0 explicitly corrected on 2026-07-04. Measured rendered widths are 0.1288/0.2080/0.1486/0.0892/0.2081/0.2080 against the spec's 0.14/0.20/0.085/0.125/0.25/0.20: the Piano band is 75% wider than specified (deviation 0.0636), Synth is 17% narrower (0.0420) and Program is 29% narrower (0.0359). Five of six are outside the 0.012 tolerance, and the narrow Program band is what pushes Transpose and the Dirty indicator off the bottom of their panel.

issues.title: Default program is permanently tremolo-modulated
issues.detail: Mod 1 ships at amount 64 with bypass false, so applyMod1 sets mod1LfoGain to 0.24 and its 4.5 Hz LFO modulates mod1Wet.gain from the first note. Every default piano note visibly warbles (envelope 6.0-5.0-3.8-2.4-1.8-1.8-2.5-3.1-3.5, ~220ms period) and the warble disappears under All Effects Bypass. The panel is at least honest about it - the Mod 1 Amount knob is genuinely at its midpoint - but the instrument's idle sound is wrong.

issues.title: Top black key overhangs the keybed
issues.detail: keybed.tsx:63 positions black keys at ((whiteBefore + 0.72) / 43) * 100%. For the final black key that is 99.35% with a 1.35% width, so it spans to 100.7% - measured at x 1405.34 + 18.72 = 1424.06 against a keybed right edge of 1414.39, a 9.7px overhang. 72 of 73 key boxes fall inside the keybed.

issues.title: Rotary Speaker block is placed in the Organ section rather than the performance band
issues.detail: organ-rotary-slow/fast/stop/drive are declared with section 'organ' (hardware.ts:119-122) and render inside the dark Organ plate. The spec's sectionLandmarks and reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg both place the Rotary Speaker block on the exposed red chassis of the performance band, below Master Level. This is the one required landmark of 33 that is not rendered in its own section.

evidence: At 1440x900 the .instrument box measures 1396.80 x 451.30 px: widthFraction 0.97000 (inside 0.88-0.97), aspectRatio 3.09507 vs 3.0951 specified, deck 243.7px = 0.53997 and keybed-wrap 207.6px = 0.45999 of instrument height - all four inside tolerance.

The six section slots measure 179.89 / 290.59 / 207.58 / 124.53 / 290.61 / 290.59 px = 0.1288 / 0.2080 / 0.1486 / 0.0892 / 0.2081 / 0.2080 against the spec's 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20. Worst deviation is piano at 0.06361 (piano is rendered 75% wider than spec), then synth 0.04195 and program 0.03585 - five of the six are outside the 0.012 tolerance.

artifact/src/model/hardware.ts SECTIONS still carries the superseded coarse fractions (0.13/0.21/0.15/0.09/0.21/0.21) that specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json v1.3.0 explicitly corrected on 2026-07-04; the rendered widths match those constants, not the spec.

32 of the 33 sectionLandmarks entries render inside their own section. The miss is 'rotary speaker controls': organ-rotary-slow/fast/stop/drive are defined with section:'organ' (artifact/src/model/hardware.ts:119-122) and render inside the Organ plate, whereas the spec and reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg place the Rotary Speaker block on the exposed red chassis of the performance band.

5x5 document.elementFromPoint hit-test over every one of the 163 [data-control-id] boxes at 1440x900, page unscrolled: 148 reachable, 15 unreachable. All 15 are fully clipped by .panel-controls{overflow:hidden} (styles.css:108-115), which has no scroll affordance - e.g. .panel-controls in Synth reports scrollHeight 227 vs clientHeight 189. The buried controls are organ-layer-b-enable, organ-layer-a/b-octave, piano-string-res, piano-sustped, piano-pstick, piano-section-on, program-transpose, program-dirty, synth-arp-range, synth-voice-poly/mono/legato, synth-glide, synth-unison. A further 17 controls are half-clipped (only 5-10 of 25 grid points hit).

Three forbidden elements are present: Organ renders a 'generic equal-width control grid' (every control is the same native range input at width:100%;max-width:3rem, laid out in one flex-wrap), Synth renders a 'uniform repeated knob matrix' (30 identical sliders in a single flow), and Layer Effects renders a 'single undifferentiated control grid' (all 31 controls in one .panel-controls wrap with no per-unit blocks or separators).

73 key elements render: 43 .key--white and 30 .key--black, matching the Stage 4 73 variant exactly. White keys 31.32px wide x 199.61px tall, black keys 18.72 x 121.75, so blackKeyHeightFraction = 0.60994 (target 0.61) and black/white width ratio 0.598.

72 of 73 key boxes fall inside the keybed box (x 25.59-1414.39): the topmost black key sits at x 1405.34 with width 18.72, so its right edge at 1424.06 overhangs the keybed by 9.7px. The offset formula in keybed.tsx:63 ((whiteBefore + 0.72) / 43) puts the final black key past 100%.

Black-key centres sit a mean 0.78px from the adjacent white-key boundary (white width 31.31px), so the black-key placement pattern itself is correct; pressed state is applied via .is-pressed and was observed changing on pointer input.

Histogram of the rendered 1396x451 instrument crop, nearest surface of >=300px per reference colour, CIE76: chassisMid #851a25 -> #78222b dE 9.48; chassisDark #5a0c13 -> #721f29 dE 9.21; panelBlueGray #3c424d -> #3c424d dE 0.00; keyBlack #0b0b0b -> #0b0b0b dE 0.00; keyWhite #dcdcdc -> #dcdcdc dE 0.00. 5/5 within dE 12.

The chassis is the weak pair: artifact/src/model/hardware.ts CHASSIS_COLORS declares chassisMid #79232c and chassisDark #721f29 rather than the spec's #851a25/#5a0c13, so the gradient is a flatter, less saturated red with almost no light-to-dark travel (dE between the artifact's own two chassis tones is under 2), but both still land inside the dE 12 band.

Every knob, encoder, fader, drawbar, wheel and pitch stick on the deck is a browser-default <input type=range> at width:100%;max-width:3rem (styles.css:182-187) with a text caption above it - there are no knob caps, no fader or drawbar bodies, no pointer indicators and no rotary switch collars anywhere on the panel. The nine 'drawbars' are horizontal sliders identical to every other control.

The nine 'level LED ladders' are single 0.35rem dots on grey toggle buttons labelled 'Drawbar 1 LED'...'Drawbar 9 LED'; no ladder or segmented meter exists. Legends render at clamp(0.28rem,0.55vw,0.45rem) = 7.2px at 1440px and truncate constantly with ellipsis ('Synth Layer A En...', 'Compressor Thre...', 'Organ Layer A Le...'). The two OLEDs are present in the correct sections with a monospace teal-on-dark treatment, which is the one piece of hardware-specific detail on the deck; the surfaces are otherwise flat CSS gradients.

What tracks correctly: key pressed state (aria-pressed and .is-pressed toggle on pointer down/up), the live status line ('Piano: ready - Voices: N', observed 0/1/2/3/18), slider positions holding their own values, and piano type selection - clicking Electric Type sets piano-type-led-2 aria-checked=true, clears piano-type-led-0, and updates the Program OLED to 'Electric Model'.

What misreports: the Program OLED never shows a program name, page or dirty state, only the piano model; the Synth OLED is frozen at 'Init Synth' regardless of any synth control; the organ model switches leave B3 and Vox both lit simultaneously while only B3 is applied; Store, Store As, Live Mode, Split, Scene I/II, the three Morph Assign buttons, Panic, Transpose Up/Down and Rotary Slow/Fast/Stop all light up as engaged with nothing behind them; and Program 1-8 latch non-exclusively. LEDs and displays therefore assert states the instrument is not in, which is the opposite of the honesty contract.

At 390x844 the instrument stays recognisable: 374x139px chassis (0.959 of viewport width), all 73 keys still laid out, both OLEDs, the branding and all six section plates still visible, documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 so there is no horizontal overflow and nothing is cut off the chassis.

It is not usable, though: the same 5x5 elementFromPoint hit-test finds only 17 of 163 controls reachable (vs 148 at desktop) because .panel-controls keeps overflow:hidden while each panel shrinks to roughly 60x45px - the Organ plate shows two sliders and the Program plate shows only the OLED. White keys measure 7.53px wide. The @media (max-width:480px) rule also hides every control caption, so the few reachable controls are unlabelled.
